messages:
sam: heads up — ran a probe on the new fp8 capability flag rollout, and saw a latency bump on a subset of SM86 hosts :thinking_face:

maria: which hosts and what bump?

sam: nv-host-12/13/14 (driver 537) —  tail p99 from ~78ms -> ~125ms for seqlen 128 when fp8 path is enabled

alex: ouch. did you repro with a clean binary or the runtime change branch?

sam: branch: feat/sm-detect-fp8-autotune. repro on both, but cleaner on the branch (we added an extra kernel fallback check)

taylor: any KV cache thrash? that often shows up when we flip kernel paths

sam: good call — microprofile shows KV miss rate spikes from 3% -> 22% around the same timeframe. stack traces point to extra tensorcore kernel fallback triggering extra KV loads

maria: can you paste the profiling snippet?

sam: ```
# microbench snippet (nv-host-12)
seq=128 model=redwood-7b variant=fp8_probe
avg_tok_latency=1.2ms p50
p99=125.4ms
kv_hits=77.9% kv_misses=22.1%
kernel_path=tc_fp8_fast -> fallback_gemm_bf16
```

alex: interesting — fallback path uses a different KV layout so it ends up doing more cache line loads, causing eviction churn
taylor: looks like our architecture detection is too eager on SM86 with driver 537. maybe detect tensorcore availability but gate fp8 if seqlen > 64?
maria: we already have seqlen gating for bf16 paths, but not for fp8. adding a hysteresis might help (avoid flip/flop on mixed workloads)
sam: agreed — quick test: force fp8 off for seqlen>=128 and re-run microbench
sam: runtime-bot: start microprobe nv-host-12 --profile --tag=fp8-gate-test
runtime-bot: acknowledged. probe queued (job id 2026) :gear:

#20m later
sam: results: p99 back to 82ms, kv_miss down to 5.1% when fp8 disabled for seqlen>=128
alex: that strongly points to kernel route mismatch for long sequences. plan: add seqlen threshold + driver-version whitelist in the capdetect heuristic, and add a metric to track kernel-route changes per request
taylor: also add a tiny cooldown counter to avoid toggling per-request (like 3 consecutive samples before switching)
maria: can we add a perf regression alert to CI that watches p99 delta > 20% on the microprobe matrix? we should catch these earlier
sam: i'll open a PR with the seqlen gating + cooldown and a short rollout plan (canary 5% on dedicated pool)
alex: add a revert toggle in the config just in case. and document the known driver 537 quirk in arch-quirks.md
maria: sounds good. thanks for catching this, sam :thumbsup:

sam: np — will post the PR link once ready

# follow-ups
- sam: PR up by EOD with tests
- taylor: add cooldown metric to runtime telemetry
- maria: create CI microprobe alert rule

sam: tagging @alex @taylor for visibility
